propositions: The DEFAULT_MODEL claude-opus-4-8 rejects temperature parameter on Bedrock with 400 ValidationException but the override table does not list it, causing hard failures when temperature is configured
Both us. and global. prefix variants of opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 reject temperature and are unguarded by the single-entry override table keyed on literal model ids

The Anthropic direct path to claude-opus-4-8 silently drops temperature via pydantic-ai but logs warnings, while production code-review Pass-2 requires temperature=0 for determinism but gets resampling instead
The sampling parameter rejection is family-wide across opus line (not just opus-4-7) and affects both temperature and top_p, but only temperature has a capability override and top_p is latent
The override table must be extended to cover bare ids and both profile prefixes or matched on family portion to prevent hard 400 failures on the default model in production
